description: This file defines the interface for the ProgramGL class, which is a GL program implementation in the ANGLE project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to OpenGL program management.

classes.name: ProgramGL
classes.description: A class implementing an OpenGL program, providing methods for linking, validation, setting uniforms, and managing program state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a program from a binary stream.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the program to a binary stream.

methods.name: setBinaryRetrievableHint
methods.description: Sets whether the binary can be retrieved.

methods.name: setSeparable
methods.description: Sets whether the program is separable.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Links the program with specified resources.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the program against the device capabilities.

methods.name: setUniform*
methods.description: Sets uniform variables of various types.

methods.name: enableLayeredRenderingPath
methods.description: Enables layered rendering path with a base view index.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the program state with the context.
